title: 第006章 家宴
content_zh:
在跟刘恢约定好之后，刘长就回到了自己的位置上。
等到老师讲完了课，刘长急忙起身，朝着刘恢眨了眨眼，刘恢点了点头，率先走出了天禄阁，刘如意伸了个懒腰，跟刘恒聊着什么，缓缓起身，他刚起身，就看到刘恒眼里的惊愕。
也就是在那一刻，一个不知来自哪里的脚狠狠踹在了他的屁股上，刘恒亲眼看着刘如意起身的那一刻，幼弟刘长凌空飞踹，将没有防备的刘如意给踹飞了，刘如意一个狗吃屎重重的摔了下去。
然刘长自然也是收不住脚摔在地上，可是他起的很快，一个鲤鱼打挺，就起来了，随即头也不回的冲出了天禄阁。
刘如意用手扶着自己起身，愤怒的咆哮：“刘长！！！”
刘长很早之前就想要揍刘如意了，这厮总是挑衅自己，看着那贱贱的表情，刘长就想给他一拳，只是刘恢总是拦着他，刘恢比他年长，又是个胖小子，他拉着刘长，刘长还真没办法去动刘如意，今天刘恢走了，啊哈，吃我一记正义飞踹！
刘恒伸出手来，将刘如意一把拽起来，刘如意拍打着身上的土，恼火的说道：“我早晚要把这小子修理一顿！”
“兄长又何必总是跟他怄气呢...兄长也非懵懂小子，明明有更多的事情可以做，又何必整日跟一个小娃娃做无用的争斗呢？”
“啊？我..这..我就是逗逗他而已...”
刘如意明明比刘恒要大两岁，可是不知道为什么，此刻却手足无措，说出不话来，脸憋得通红，有种深深的羞耻感，居然比自己小两岁的弟弟说自己不够成熟。
“兄长，正如您方才所说，我们将来是要治理一方天下的。”
“战乱刚刚结束，各地缺少粮食，农具，百姓们过的并不好...我们何其有幸，生在帝王之家，可是在这城墙之外，像我们这样大的孩子们，饿着肚子，还在农田里做耕牛...饿死累死者何其多啊。”
刘如意脸色涨红，支支吾吾的。
刘恒没有再说什么，转身就要离开。
刘如意苦笑着说道：“有什么比被自己年少两岁的弟弟训斥幼稚更丢人的事情呢？”
“被年少五岁的弟弟踹屁股。”
刘恒回了一句，便头也不回的离开了。
这群弟弟真的是一点都不可爱！
刘如意摸着鼻梁暗自想着。
.......

“长弟啊，我这从哪里给你找纺车啊。”
刘恢欲哭无泪，他也没有想到，刘长找到他，居然是想让自己给他弄台纺车。
刘长思索了片刻，又说道：“那就给我弄把刀...我自己动手。”
“啊？动手？？”
刘恢被吓了一跳，他急忙抓住刘长的手臂，“兄弟之间，怎么可以动刀动剑呢？三哥其实也很爱你的...上次你昏迷不醒的时候，他每天都去看望你，太医令说你醒不过来的时候，他哭的很伤心...”
“他哭是因为没有可以欺负的人了吧...不过，这跟我说的事没关系啊。”
刘长解释道：“我看阿母给我们织冬衣，那么的幸苦...所以呢，我想要给她做一台新的纺车，其实很简单，就是把现在的一个纺轮一个锭改成一个纺轮多个锭...但是阿母不让我碰她那个纺车，我这又没有什么工具。”
刘恢神色怪异的看着刘长，仿佛在说：傻子才相信你的鬼话。
刘长很是着急。
他真的没有说谎。
在那模糊的记忆里，他前世是干油井的，可这样简陋的机械，他看几眼还是能轻易的发现问题。来自未来的记忆里，他年少的时候就喜欢动手拆屋，奶奶曾有一台纺织机，脚踏的那种老款纺织机，为了搞明白原理，他曾动手拆过。
如今这种简陋纺织机，改进的空间实在是太大，若是他能找到一些工具，他能做出一台非常先进的纺织机，阿母也就不会那么幸苦。
可问题是，他真的搞不到工具啊。
首先，他这个年纪的皇子是不能随意出宫的，而皇宫里头，他能接触到的只有宦官和宫女，宦官们是不能将宫外的东西带进来的，否则便要处死。
虽然大汉王朝对秦朝的律法进行了一定的改正，可这律法毕竟是脱胎与大秦，动不动就是“剃胡子”，“修皇宫”，“剁脚趾”的全套服务，服务周全，效率又高，敢违法的都是勇士中的勇士，好汉中的好汉。
刘长想要改进纺车，别的工具可以没有，但是木工刀不能没有啊。
刘恢只是摇着头，他也没办法给刘长弄来刀子，就是能弄来，也绝对不会给他的。
对此，刘长也做出了让步，“行了，没刀也行，那就给我弄把斧子，怎么样？”
“不怎么样...”
“你既然有这孝心，为什么不直接跟阿母要呢？”

“你懂什么...这叫惊喜啊！”
刘长皱着眉头，他要怎么才能在戒备森严的皇宫里找到像样的工具呢？
忽然间，他似乎想到了什么，目光缓缓投向了长信宫，若是自己没有记错，那里有不少的侍卫，而且这些侍卫都是全副武装的吧...刘长忽然低着头，“阴险”的笑了起来。
“长弟啊...无论你在想什么，都千万不要去做啊！”
刘恢语重心长的说着。
“我记得三哥就有佩剑，为什么不跟三哥借呢？”
忽然，有人开口提醒道。
刘长转身一看，这才注意到开口说话的人居然是刘友。
“吓我一跳！你什么时候来的啊？”
“我一直都在这里啊...”，刘友低着头，双手交缠在一起，小声的回答道。
刘如意的确是有佩剑的，刘如意是个很特别的皇子，因为深受宠爱，他可以出宫，他可以佩剑，他还可以不打招呼就去找刘邦...但是，跟刘如意借？自己刚才才踹了他一脚，让他摔了个狗吃屎，他能借给自己吗？
找他借剑，他怕不是要跟自己借项上人头？
刘长有些迟疑，他告别了刘恢，沉思着回到了椒房殿内。
刘邦是个喜欢热闹的人，不喜欢孤寂，因此他很喜欢开宴会，要么是跟老哥们喝酒吃肉，要么就是跟家里人一起吃吃喝喝。
在今天晚上，刘邦决定再召开一次家庭宴会，刘长是很喜欢这样的宴席的，因为在宴席上会有很多好吃的。别看他贵为皇子，可平日里吃的并不算太好，主食不是粟就是麦，黄色的麦饭，令人没有食欲。
偶尔吃个蒸饼，也是软塌塌的，一口咬下去，没有任何味道，像是吃沙子。
肉食也不是那么的好吃，一般就是狗肉，鸡肉或猪肉，没有什么调料，简直无法下咽。
只有宴会上，能吃到各种各样的水果，蔬菜，还能吃到牛肉，羊肉，马肉等。
为了迎接这次的宴席，刘长从早上开始就没有吃东西了，他一直在默默等着晚上的宴席。
当吕后牵着刘长参宴的时候，众人差不多都到了，刘煓，刘邦，曹夫人，戚夫人，薄姬，管夫人，赵子儿，石美人、唐姬等人都在，太子，刘如意，刘恒，刘恢当然也在。

在吕后到来的那一刻，除却刘老太爷夫妇和刘邦之外，其余众人都是要起身行礼的，戚夫人就坐在刘邦的身边，半个身子几乎要贴上去了，在吕后进来之后，也是犹如触电般迅速起身。
面对众人的行礼，吕后表情冷漠，甚至都没有回礼，直接前去拜见刘太公和老夫人。
刘太公笑呵呵的回礼，同时朝着刘长挥了挥手。
刘长笑着冲到了太公的身边，叫道：“爷爷！”
刘长前世就是被爷爷奶奶所带大的，与他们非常的亲近，在这两个老人的模样渐渐与自己印象里的爷爷奶奶重合之后，刘长就非常喜欢腻着这两个老人了。
“哎呀，就等着你来呢，来，吃肉，吃肉！”
太公直接拿着肉就往刘长嘴边递，太公手里拿着肉，老夫人手里拿着水果，两人一左一右，笑吟吟的看着刘长。太公是刘长的亲爷爷，可老夫人并不是，老夫人是太公的妾室。
但是刘邦对她却非常的孝顺，在登基之后，将她当作亲母来对待，还封她为太上皇后。
刘长是在这里的孙子里最小的，自然也是最受老人宠爱的，比他小的刘建还在襁褓里呢。
content_en:
After making an agreement with Liu Hui, Liu Chang returned to his position.
When the teacher finished his lecture, Liu Chang stood up quickly and winked at Liu Hui. Liu Hui nodded and walked out of Tianlu Pavilion first. Liu Ruyi stretched, chatted with Liu Heng and stood up slowly. As soon as he stood up, he saw the shock in Liu Heng's eyes.
At that moment, a foot from nowhere kicked him hard on his butt. Liu Heng watched with his own eyes the moment Liu Ruyi got up, his younger brother Liu Chang flew into the air and kicked the unsuspecting Liu Ruyi away. Liu Ruyi fell down hard like a dog.
Of course, Liu Chang couldn't hold his feet and fell to the ground, but he got up very quickly, stood up like a carp, and then rushed out of Tianlu Pavilion without looking back.
Liu Ruyi helped herself up with her hands and roared angrily: "Liu Chang!!!"
Liu Chang wanted to punch Liu Ruyi a long time ago. This guy always provoked him. Looking at that mean expression, Liu Chang wanted to punch him, but Liu Hui always stopped him. Liu Hui was older than him and a fat boy. He pulled Liu Chang, but Liu Chang really couldn't touch Liu Ruyi. Today Liu Hui left, ahha, give me a righteous kick!
Liu Heng stretched out his hand and pulled Liu Ruyi up. Liu Ruyi patted the dirt on his body and said angrily: "Sooner or later, I will fix this kid!"
"Brother, why do you have to be angry with him all the time...Brother is not an ignorant boy. There are obviously more things to do, so why bother fighting with a little baby all day long?"
"Ah? I...this...I'm just teasing him..."
Liu Ruyi was obviously two years older than Liu Heng, but for some reason, she was at a loss for words at this moment. Her face turned red and she felt deeply ashamed that her brother, who was two years younger than her, said that she was not mature enough.
"Brother, as you just said, we will rule the world in the future."
"The war has just ended. There is a lack of food and farm tools everywhere, and the people are not living a good life... We are so lucky to be born in an emperor's family, but outside the city walls, children like us are hungry and still working as cattle in the farmland... There are so many people who have died of starvation and exhaustion."
Liu Ruyi's face turned red and he hesitated.
Liu Heng said nothing more, turned around and left.
Liu Ruyi smiled bitterly and said, "What is more embarrassing than being scolded by your brother who is two years younger than being childish?"
"Kicked in the butt by my brother who is five years younger."
Liu Heng replied and left without looking back.
These little brothers are really not cute at all!
Liu Ruyi touched the bridge of her nose and thought to herself.
.......
"Eldest brother, where can I find a spinning wheel for you?"
Liu Hui was about to cry, but he didn't expect that Liu Chang found him and wanted him to get him a spinning wheel.
Liu Chang thought for a moment and then said: "Then get me a knife...I will do it myself."
"Ah? Do it?"
Liu Hui was startled, and he hurriedly grabbed Liu Chang's arm, "How can we use swords and swords between brothers? Third brother actually loves you very much... When you were unconscious last time, he visited you every day. When the imperial doctor said that you couldn't wake up, he cried very sadly..."
"He's crying because he has no one to bully...but it has nothing to do with what I'm talking about."
Liu Chang explained: "I saw my grandma knitting winter clothes for us, and it was so hard... So, I wanted to make her a new spinning wheel. It's actually very simple, just change the current one spinning wheel and one spindle into a spinning wheel with multiple spindles... But my grandma wouldn't let me touch her spinning wheel, and I don't have any tools."
Liu Hui looked at Liu Chang with a strange expression, as if to say: Only fools believe your lies.
Liu Chang was very anxious.
He really wasn't lying.
in that blurIn his memory, he worked in an oil well in his previous life, but with such a crude machine, he could easily find problems after just a few glances. In his memory from the future, he liked to dismantle houses when he was young. His grandmother once had a textile machine, an old-style foot-operated textile machine. In order to understand the principle, he once dismantled it.
There is really too much room for improvement in this simple textile machine. If he could find some tools, he could make a very advanced textile machine, and his mother would not be so miserable.
But the problem is, he really can't get the tools.
First of all, a prince of his age cannot leave the palace at will, and the only people he can come into contact with in the palace are eunuchs and maids. The eunuchs are not allowed to bring in things from outside the palace, otherwise they will be executed.
Although the Han Dynasty made some corrections to the laws of the Qin Dynasty, this law was born out of the Qin Dynasty after all. It was a full set of services including "shaving beards", "building palaces", and "cutting off toes". The services were comprehensive and efficient. Those who dared to break the law were the brave among the brave and the best among the heroes.
Liu Chang wanted to improve the spinning wheel. He could do without other tools, but he couldn't do without the carpenter's knife.
Liu Hui just shook his head. He couldn't get Liu Chang a knife. Even if he could get it, he would never give it to him.
In this regard, Liu Chang also made concessions, "Okay, you can do it without a knife, how about you get me an ax?"
"Not so good..."
"Since you have such filial piety, why don't you just ask my mother for it?"
"What do you know...this is called a surprise!"
Liu Chang frowned, how could he find decent tools in the heavily guarded palace?
Suddenly, he seemed to have thought of something, and his eyes slowly turned to Changxin Palace. If he remembered correctly, there were a lot of guards there, and these guards were all fully armed... Liu Chang suddenly lowered his head and laughed "sinisterly".
"Eldest brother... no matter what you are thinking about, don't do it!"
Liu Hui said seriously.
"I remember that Third Brother has a sword. Why not borrow it from Third Brother?"
Suddenly, someone reminded me.
Liu Chang turned around and noticed that the person who spoke was actually Liu You.
"I was shocked! When did you come?"
"I've always been here..." Liu You lowered his head, intertwined his hands, and replied in a low voice.
Liu Ruyi does have a sword. Liu Ruyi is a very special prince. Because he is deeply loved, he can leave the palace, he can wear a sword, and he can go to Liu Bang without saying hello... But, borrow it from Liu Ruyi? I just kicked him and made him lose his shit. Can he lend it to me?
If you ask him to borrow a sword, is he afraid that he will be killed if you borrow it from him?
Liu Chang hesitated a little. He said goodbye to Liu Hui and returned to Jiaofang Hall in deep thought.
Liu Bang is a person who likes liveliness and dislikes loneliness, so he likes to hold banquets, either drinking and eating meat with his old buddies, or eating and drinking with his family.
Tonight, Liu Bang decided to hold another family banquet. Liu Chang liked this kind of banquet very much, because there would be a lot of delicious food at the banquet. Although he is a prince, his food is not very good on weekdays. The staple food is either millet or wheat. The yellow wheat rice is unappetizing.
Occasionally, I eat a steamed pancake, which is soft and tasteless when I bite it, like eating sand.
The meat is not that delicious either. It is usually dog ​​meat, chicken or pork. There is no seasoning and it is simply inedible.
Only at the banquet, you can eat a variety of fruits and vegetables, as well as beef, mutton, horse meat, etc.
In order to welcome this banquet, Liu Chang had not eaten since the morning. He had been silently waiting for the banquet in the evening.
When Empress Lu led Liu Chang to the banquet, everyone was almost there. LiuXuan, Liu Bang, Mrs. Cao, Mrs. Qi, Bo Ji, Mrs. Guan, Zhao Zier, Shi Meiren, Tang Ji and others are all there, and of course the prince, Liu Ruyi, Liu Heng, and Liu Hui are also there.
The moment Empress Lu arrived, everyone except Mr. Liu, his wife and Liu Bang had to stand up and salute. Mrs. Qi sat next to Liu Bang, half of her body almost touching her. After Empress Lu came in, she stood up quickly as if she was electrocuted.
Facing everyone's salutes, Empress Lu looked indifferent and did not even return the salutes. She went directly to pay homage to Taigong Liu and the old lady.
Taigong Liu smiled in return and waved towards Liu Chang.
Liu Chang rushed to the grandfather's side with a smile and shouted: "Grandpa!"
Liu Chang was raised by his grandparents in his previous life and was very close to them. After the appearance of these two old people gradually overlapped with his grandparents in his impression, Liu Chang became very fond of these two old people.
"Oh, I'm just waiting for you to come. Come, eat meat, eat meat!"
The grandpa directly took the meat and handed it to Liu Chang's mouth. The grandpa held the meat in his hand, and the old lady held the fruit in her hand. The two of them looked at Liu Chang with a smile. The grandpa is Liu Chang's biological grandfather, but the old lady is not. The old lady is the concubine of the grandpa.
But Liu Bang was very filial to her. After he ascended the throne, he treated her as his biological mother and named her Supreme Queen.
Liu Chang is the youngest among the grandchildren here, and is naturally the most favored by the old man. Liu Jian, who is younger than him, is still in his infancy.
